slices.focus: Chronic back management shifts from fighting to morning stretching, PT consistency, and softball pause
slices.summary: Derek finally admits his back is not going to 'fix' through toughness and commits to a consistent management routine: morning stretching, sticking with physical therapy, and cutting out the occasional softball that was aggravating his condition. The improvements are modest — the brutal lock-up episodes ease off, long teaching days become more manageable — but he learns to treat the one-sided tightness as a yellow-light signal rather than ignoring it. He decides to pause softball completely for a defined period with a check-in point based on functional stability, not mood.
open_loops: Writing down the morning routine in a visible place to prevent freelancing
Setting a check-in date for the softball pause with functional criteria
Shortening the weekend version of the stretching routine
Building automaticity: same order, same place, no decision-making
